create_classifier: create a Classifier instance with samples dictionary and input dimension for neural architecture search
train_classifier: train the Classifier model using MSE loss on network samples and accuracy labels
predict_accuracy: predict accuracy scores for remaining network architectures using the trained Classifier model
split_predictions: split predicted network architectures into good and bad samples based on average accuracy threshold
split_data: train the Classifier and split existing samples into good and bad based on predicted mean accuracy
